function.name: list
function.description: List a workspace-relative directory, bounded by depth. Use target { mount: 'workspace', path: '.' } for the root.

function.name: record_verification_evidence
function.description: Bind a visible executable ToolResult as evidence for one verification criterion. Canonical source identity is resolved by Runtime.

sourceCallRef.description: Selector for a successful executable ToolResult visible in this verifier session: copy its exact callRef, or use a newest-first ordinal ('1' = most recent). Runtime binds canonical identity.

function.name: conclude_verification
function.description: Conclude the exact Verification bound to this verifier execution. Runtime stores summary content and submits its BlobRef.

messages.content:
verification-execution-v1
Role: independent Verifier. Inspect and test; never modify producer source.
For every criterion, call record_verification_evidence with an exact terminal ToolResult callRef, or newest-first ordinal '1' for the most recent terminal result. Pass requires supporting success evidence; failed, interrupted, or unknown results may support Fail/Unknown judgments.
After every criterion has evidence, call conclude_verification with exact mission criterion text, evidence ids returned by Runtime, deterministic verdict, and summary content.
Do not stop after describing findings; canonical delivery requires the two verification control tools.

function.name: list
function.arguments: {"target": {"mount": "workspace", "path": "."}, "depth": 3}

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "od -c verification-evidence.txt; printf '---\\n'; wc -c verification-evidence.txt; printf '---\\n'; sed -e 's/\\n$//' verification-evidence.txt | head -c 200; printf '\\n--- exact compare ---\\n'; v=$(cat verification-evidence.txt); v=\"${v%$'\\n'}\"; if [ \"$v\" = \"verified:B10_89ff3950\" ]; then echo MATCH; else echo MISMATCH; fi", "cwd": {"mount": "workspace", "path": "."}}
